positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and delivered resilient features for Microsoft Entra Connect Sync, Cloud Sync & Provisioning Agent, enabling reliable synchronization of on-premises directory objects with Microsoft Entra. Produced maintainable, extensible code using C#, C++, PowerShell, Azure Cosmos DB, and Microsoft SQL Server; led design reviews, identified root causes of synchronization and performance issues, and drove data-informed design and lifecycle improvements across releases.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained features for the Assignment module in the MHE Open Learning project such as the API, content selector, flow, assignment creator, etc. Also, ensured the other modules such as the Assess Delivery, Assess Authoring, Course Map, Calendar, etc integrated smoothly with our module.
Used technologies such as Laravel, Angular, PHP, jQuery, Docker for development.
Designed, developed and integrated new features to editor tools and answer processing rules for ALEKS software using JavaScript, XML, HTML5, CSS3, SVG, Canvas.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Integrating Apache Tika with MIT Lincoln Lab’s Text.jl library as a REST service for language detection using Maven, Java, Julia (programming language) and Shell Script for DARPA’s MEMEX Project.

positions.title: Application Developer (Student Worker)
positions.description: Developed and maintained C#, ASP.NET web applications and C#, Visual Basic desktop applications for generating reports from multiple CSV files, Excel sheets and data files. Used Microsoft Team Foundation Server (TFS) for version control.

positions.title: Application Support Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Benchmarked MATLAB Connector’s performance by writing automated performance tests for Latency, Message Size vs Message Frequency and Maximum Size of Message using MATLAB, Dojo Toolkit, QUnit and Benchmark.js. The metrics generated was shared with other teams that use connector publish-­subscribe APIs.
- Provided application support to MathWorks customers for highly complex technical issues in MATLAB and MathWorks product suite.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the requirements elicitation and analysis for a Content Management System website
- Implemented, tested, deployed and maintained websites and web applications such as a Social Networking website and Content Management System website using technologies such as PHP, CodeIgniter, HTML, CSS, jQuery, Bootstrap.
- Trained Interns in Web Technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery, PHP and CodeIgniter

volunteerExperiences.description: This NGO is deeply involved in holistic community development of people. My role was to teach children, who cannot afford or avail private tuitions and thereby to sharpen their skills and form a stronger foundation for acquiring further skills.

projects.description: Implemented an android application to perform property search and post details to Facebook using Amazon cloud computing (AWS), Zillow API, Facebook API and SDK.
